title: Release orchestra: preflight grid and weekly cadence (June 2026 diary)
content:
Purpose:
This is a working diary + actionable preflight grid for the June 2026 release window. It combines a weekly cadence, day-by-day preflight checklist, a terse rollout calendar, and a draft release notes section to ship with minimum friction.

Context / audience:
- Primary: Release engineers + on-call SREs running the cutover.
- Secondary: Product PMs, infra owners, and solutions engineering for customer comms.

General constraints / decision notes (quick):
- Targeted slice: hosted API + dedicated pools (no private code drop this cycle).
- Canary window: 6 hours with automated canary metric gates.
- Safety lane: auto-fallback to previous model variant + regional routing to standby region.
- Telemetry: token-latency p50/p95, error-rate, qps, model-compatibility regressions.

High-level cadence (week leading to go-live):
- D-7 (Mon): Code freeze for release branch. Finalize release notes draft and gating ticket list.
- D-5 (Wed): Preflight smoke tests in staging, begin canary harness setup.
- D-3 (Fri): Dry-run cutover in staging -> brief postmortem notes.
- D-1 (Sun): On-call rota confirmed, incident channel announced, last-minute rollback drill.
- D0 (Mon): 03:00 UTC start, 6-hour canary, incremental traffic ramp to 100% over next 4 hours if gates pass.
- D+1 (Tue): Followup sampling, quality regression scans, billing/usage sanity checks.

Preflight grid (day-by-day actionable matrix) — each bullet is a TODO box to update with results:
D-7: Code freeze
- [ ] Branch cut: release/2026-06-xx created, tag conventions verified (release-2026-06-xx).
- [ ] Linked PRs reconciled: list PRs in RED-2412.
- [ ] Final test matrix approved by QA owner (Maya).
- [ ] Release notes: features + known issues stub ready.

D-5: Staging smoke
- [ ] Deploy release branch to staging cluster (staging-ops-02).
- [ ] Run smoke script (scripts/release/smoke-smpl.sh) across 3 model lengths (128, 512, 2048).
- [ ] KV cache warmup run for 30 minutes. Capture baseline p50/p95.
- [ ] Validate telemetry ingestion to Observability (console: /dash/release-2026-06).

D-3: Dry-run & rollback drill
- [ ] Execute dry-run cutover runbook end-to-end (conductor play sequence).
- [ ] Simulate failover: throttle serving nodes to trigger fallback; verify auto-fallback to variant-A.
- [ ] Time the rollback path (goal < 10 minutes to stable).
- [ ] Update runbook if timings exceed budget.

D-1: Final readiness
- [ ] Confirm on-call rotation: primary, secondary, surge. Names posted to Slack and pager.rotations.
- [ ] Final backup snapshot of model artifacts and serving configs -> S3 release-snapshots/2026-06-xx.
- [ ] Security: confirm KMS access audit and key policy (security sign-off).
- [ ] Legal/Compliance: any data policy notes for this drop? (flag: none expected).

D0: Release day checklist (sequential)
Pre-start (T-30m)
- [ ] Brief in #release-orchestra: objectives, partial rollbacks, kill-switches.
- [ ] Ensure canary harness is green and traffic shaping policy set (10% initial).
- [ ] Confirm alert thresholds in dashboard (p95 > 400ms, error-rate > 0.8%).

Start (T0)
- [ ] Kick canary: route 2% traffic to release variant in region-us-west-2.
- [ ] Monitor live metrics every 5 minutes for first 30 minutes.
- [ ] Run automated functional smoke (synthetic prompts + known outputs) every 10 minutes.
- [ ] If gate fails, execute rollback path: route all traffic back to prior variant and stop rollout.

Ramp (T+1h to T+6h)
- [ ] 2% -> 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 75% -> 100% (step every ~45–60 mins based on gate health).
- [ ] At each step: confirm p50/p95, errors, CPU/GPU utilization, and model quality metric (eval set score).
- [ ] Callout: at 50% milestone run full sampling job (1000 sample requests across endpoints).

Post-100% (T+6h to T+24h)
- [ ] Stabilization checks: sampling, billing sanity, logs for increased 5xx bursts.
- [ ] Open post-release retrospective note (template linked).

Rollback decision matrix (short)
- Automatic rollback: sustained error-rate > 0.8% for 10 minutes OR p95 latency > 1.5x baseline for 15 minutes.
- Manual rollback: product owner or release lead observes critical regression (user-facing incorrect responses for top-100 prompts).
- Emergency kill-switch: route traffic to standby region + pause all ramp steps.

Owner / roles mapping (who does what)
- Release lead: Eleanor Park (primary decision authority during D0).
- SRE/On-call lead: Ravi Desai (manages canary harness, rollbacks).
- QA lead: Maya Chen (sanity checks, sample-run approvals).
- Observability SME: Oscar Nguyen (dashboards, alert tuning).
- PM communications: Lina Brooks (user comms + status updates).

Observability & gating details (quick links)
- Canary dashboard: /dash/release-orchestra-canary (Observability console).
- Smoke scripts: repo: github.com/redwood-inference/release-scripts (PR #456 is the staging fixes).
- Logs: central logging /log/release-2026-06 (retention 30d).

Release notes (draft) — intended for public release portal and internal changelog
Version: 2026.06.10 (draft)
Highlights:
- New: Adaptive batching layer enabled for text-generation endpoints. Expect average token-latency decrease ~12% for long sequences.
- Improvement: KV cache warmup reduced cold-start latency by ~30% for resumed conversations.
- Fix: Resolved race condition in streaming response handler that could cause truncated outputs under heavy load.

Known issues (callouts):
- Intermittent edge-case where function-calling responses may re-order arguments for deeply nested json payloads — patch scheduled in next sprint.
- Billing attribution for reserved pools may show temporary mismatch in usage labels for up to 24 hours post-rollout.

Rollout impact / customer notes:
- No downtime expected for hosted API customers.
- Dedicated customers on scheduled maintenance windows will see a small reconnection during final ramp; SRE will coordinate with account managers.

Release notes TODOs:
- [ ] Get PM sign-off on public blurb (Lina).
- [ ] Confirm wording with security (if we mention KV cache improvement).
- [ ] Attach benchmark artifacts to release page (link to perf csv).

Post-release tasks (D+1 to D+7)
- [ ] 24-hour stability check: run extended sampling for top-10 customers.
- [ ] Billing/usage reconciliation (finance owner loop).
- [ ] Postmortem: compile any incidents, decisions, and action items.
- [ ] Backport: prepare any hotfix backports to release branch if needed.

Open questions / things to resolve before D-1
- Who is the final approver for the billing-metrics label change? (tagging: finance@redwood)
- Confirm whether any enterprise customers need a heads-up email before we flip 50% traffic (list from account management).
- Does Dedicated-policy require a separate rollback play? (Oscar: check dedicated routing policy TTLs).

Notes to self (Eleanor)
- Keep list of 'stop-words' for public notes in case legal flags anything.
- Make a short 1-paragraph paragraph for the customer-facing changelog that avoids technical jargon.

Appendix (short links / references)
- Confluence runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RELS/Release+Orchestra+Playbook
- Jira epic: RED-2412 (release umbrella)
- PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-scripts/pull/456, https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/981
- Slack channel: #release-orchestra

----
Status: working draft — will iterate after D-3 dry run.

(End of file)
